actors.description: Near-side player seen from behind, black sleeveless top over white short-sleeved shirt, black shorts, dark shoes with white soles; carries racket in left hand held low at his side, feeds shuttles with a raised right hand; stands on the right half of the near court.
Far-side player facing the camera, dark maroon/black top, light grey trousers, holds racket in right hand; positioned around the centre of the far court in a crouched ready stance.

storyline: Single static shot of an indoor blue badminton court with green surrounds and sponsor banners overhead. S02-P01 (near, back to camera) performs two bare-hand overhand feeds: at ~3.9 s he releases a shuttle from his raised right hand and it descends across the net into S02-P02's right forecourt (screen left); S02-P02 lunges forward and plays a low underarm stroke (~4.5-4.6 s), the shuttle then climbs steeply above the net tape (visible at 4.667 s) and exits the top of the tracked view, after which S02-P02's racket finishes high (4.767-4.967 s) and he steps back to a ready stance by ~5.3 s. Both players hold position until ~5.7 s, when S02-P01 again raises the shuttle in his right hand and releases it (~6.0 s); the second feed descends to the same forecourt area (6.1-6.5 s). S02-P02 lunges once more, strikes low near the net (~6.6 s), and the shuttle rises above the net (6.767-6.867 s) before leaving view; his follow-through keeps the racket up through ~7.2 s before he recovers to an upright ready stance. The clip ends with S02-P01 still standing with racket lowered at his left side and S02-P02 in a crouched ready position; no racket stroke by S02-P01 is visible in this shot, his deliveries are bare-hand tosses.

actions.detail: Reaching step into the right forecourt with loaded forward reach; overlaps the stroke event. Boundaries estimated on the 0.1 s grid.

actions.evidence: Underarm preparation with racket low and forward on his right side (racket in right hand, facing camera) at 4.467-4.567 s; shuttle tracked near the racket at (525,530)/(535,552) at 4.467-4.567 s, then climbing steeply to (578,322), above the net tape, at 4.667 s and exiting the top of frame by 4.767 s; racket follow-through finishes high at 4.767-4.967 s. uncertainties: The outgoing shuttle path after each strike is only visible rising above the net and exiting the top of frame; the eventual landing point (depth into the near court) is not captured, so the strokes are labeled upward return rather than lift.
Exact racket-shuttle contact frames fall between sampled frames; contact times 4.6 s and 6.6 s are estimates.

S02-P01's deliveries are bare-hand overhand tosses (shuttle released from the raised right hand at ≈3.9 s and ≈6.0 s); no racket contact by him is visible, so no stroke is annotated for him. His racket appears carried in the left hand, but handedness is not confirmed by any stroke.
S02-P02's recovery foot patterns (chasse vs plain steps) cannot be resolved at this camera distance, so recoveries are labeled generically.
No split step or other preparatory hop by S02-P02 is clearly visible before either lunge; only a crouched ready stance is observed.
